content.thinking:
I'm drafting a plain paragraph that names the duration and customer loss, with the peak error rate as an optional detail. The affected group is shoppers who visited their account pages, not everyone. The fix was that Argus reverted the monthly-spend-feature flag, and I'm now writing out the demo user's resolution.

I'm settling on the wording now: no one was paged, so the responders' cost was nothing. I'm steering clear of "brief" and moving on to the draft.

input.overview: On io-shop, account pages failed for shoppers who opened them for {duration}. Turning on a new monthly-spending feature made those pages run a calculation that tried to divide by zero. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests failed. Argus estimates the incident cost the shop {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody was paged, so no on-call responder was called in. To end it, Argus reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature, and that change is still in place. A demo user then closed the incident from the Argus UI before Argus had judged whether the revert worked. The demo user noted that they had kept the flag off and told the checkout team.
